newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France Europe traffic disrupted by snap strike.
newsitem.headline: Air France Europe traffic disrupted by snap strike.

text.p: A snap one-day pilot strike at Air France Europe, the domestic wing of the Air France group, disrupted air travel in France on Sunday.
Air Inter Europe flights except those to the island of Corsica were cancelled, leaving passengers scrambling to make alternative travel arrangements.
A few Air Inter Europe flights were expected to resume late on Sunday night, and traffic was expected to return to normal on Monday, Paris airport authorities said.
The snap strike was called late on Saturday by four unions representing a majority of Air France Europe pilots.

The USPNT, SPIT, SNPNAC and SNPL unions are protesting against a new system to lease planes from other carriers and a plan announced last year to merge Air France Europe, formerly Air Inter, into the main international airline Air France.
The plan would cut some money-losing routes and bring Air France Europe pilots' salaries in line with those at the international operation which are around 15 percent lower.
